verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains speed claims ("extremely fast", a "performance boost" via the pip interface) and one docs example whose CLI output shows timings ("Resolved 1 package in 6ms / Installed 1 package in 2ms"), but no published benchmark suite or comparison tables. The only benchmarking reference is a community report from Plotly, which says most of the speed gain disappears when uv is configured to behave like pip; that qualifies the claims rather than backing them, and other community items are anecdotal praise. Missing for 10: official published benchmark results or methodology, comparative numbers against pip/poetry, reproducible measurements, independent quantitative corroboration.
